question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In panel A of Figure 2C-13 (Sheet 1 of 5), "Freeway or expressway - lane ends," the sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends symbol sign, W4-2R. It is placed at the advance placement distance determined from Table 2C-3, while the RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) word sign with a 1000 FEET (W16-2P) plaque appears farther upstream as an optional supplement. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - The W9-1R sign is labeled "(optional)" in the figure, indicating it is a permitted supplement upstream of the W4-2R sign (the figure itself notes this; the option provision in the text evidence addresses a different placement situation beyond intersections). Visual evidence: [Image 1] and [Image 2] show Figure 2C-13, Sheet 1 of 5, panel A, with the W4-2R symbol sign positioned closest to the start of the right-lane taper (dimensioned per Table 2C-3) and the W9-1R (optional) with W16-2P "1000 FEET" plaque located farther downstream in the drawing (upstream in the direction of travel). [Image 4] (Figure 3B-14) similarly shows the W4-2R sign as the sign nearest the lane-reduction taper, with W9-1R (optional) and W16-2P plaque upstream. [Image 5] shows the left-lane counterparts (W4-2L) in the same relative position for other panels of Figure 2C-13. [Image 3] shows Sheet 5 (two-lanes-to-one merge with W4-8), which is a different condition than the freeway lane-ends sequence. Citations: - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Section 2C.47 Support §1 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Support §2 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Page 226 - Page 608
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
